json.reasoning: The only removable target is the audio asset asset-1 ('Remove audio asset-1 only'). Because that asset is the sole binding for the fixed selected performance in transcript_uses, removing it forces the dependent choice to be resolved in the same patch; otherwise the document stays invalid. No replacement audio source was supplied, and new media cannot be invented, so the dependent selection is cleared rather than rebound. The caller's words are preserved exactly by moving them into dialogue ('We close at six, not half past.', speaker 'the man at the counter'), so the spoken line is not lost — only the audio-source binding is. Note the tension: the caller also asked to keep 'their source selection unchanged', which is impossible once the source is removed; this patch preserves the words themselves and surfaces the need to supply a replacement audio asset if the selected take must remain a source rather than dialogue. All other fields (intent, seconds 8, aspect 16:9, mode ref2va, creativity balanced, effort standard) are untouched because the instruction scopes the change to asset-1 only.
